stories.headline: Paul Seixas becomes the youngest winner of Il Lombardia
stories.summary: Il Lombardia, a one-day road cycling race, held its 120th edition on 10 October. The French rider Paul Seixas won it, and is now the youngest winner of the Giro di Lombardia. The race ran 239 km from Bergamo to Como.

stories.headline: Two stolen Renoir paintings are recovered in France
stories.summary: Four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir were stolen from the Musée Renoir in Cagnes-sur-Mer, in France, on 8 September. Two were abandoned by the thieves and found in the museum's garden. The other two, Young Woman at the Well and Madame Colonna Romano, have now been recovered, and six suspects have been arrested.

stories.headline: A cheek swab from the world's oldest land animal
stories.summary: Jonathan, an Aldabra giant tortoise, is about 194 years old and the oldest land animal alive today. Scientists have taken a cheek swab from him to read his DNA. They hope his genetics will provide clues to extending lifespan in humans.
